title: What Is an AI Agent?

reader_summary.headline: Today, we're discussing one of the busiest and most confusing terms in AI right now, agents.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we're discussing one of the busiest and most confusing terms in AI right now, agents. Are they just fancy wrappers around LLMs, full-blown autonomous workers, or something in between? A16Z InfraPartners, Guido Appenzeller, Matt Bornstein and Yoko Li break down the technical definitions, pricing models, use cases.

thesis: The speakers argue that the term 'AI agent' is currently a poorly defined and overloaded concept used to describe a continuum ranging from simple clever prompts to fully autonomous systems approaching AGI. They suggest that while true agents requiring complex planning, tool use, and independent decision-making over long periods are a decade away, the market currently features 'weekend demo' versions that blur the line between chatbots, co-pilots, and actual agents.
